mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.event_id, t.title, t.price, t.original_price, t.type, t.status, s.stock, s.begin_time, s.end_time, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_ticket_waitlist w WHERE w.ticket_id = t.id AND w.status IN (0, 1)) AS has_waitlist FROM tb_ticket t LEFT JOIN tb_ticket_stock s ON t.id = s.ticket_id WHERE t.event_id = #{eventId} AND t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.price DESC
